thread:
emma (support): Heads up — AcmeCorp reporting intermittent 503/504s on /v1/generate when they run ~6 concurrent streaming requests. Happens after ~10s of token churn, then gateway times out. customer request_id=req_0a1b2c3d. SDK v0.12.3. Can we triage?

joseph (eng-infra): Thanks — can you paste the minimal repro and any response headers?

emma (support): Repro curl they ran (sanitized):
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","stream":true,"prompt":"<long prompt>"}'
```
Response: intermittent 504, body stopped mid-chunk. Headers we saw: `x-rw-gateway: queue_full`, `x-rw-node: edge-23`, `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d`.

sarah (oncall): Console shows per-route queue_depth spike around the same times for their tenant. p95 queue wait up to 8s. Any kvcache misses correlate?

deepak (eng-runtime): Possibly backpressure deadlock between streaming writers and prefix KV cache fetches. When many streams hit a cold prefix, worker threads block on fetch while new requests queue on the same worker -> queue fills and edge returns 504.

acme-support (customer): Happens ~3-4x/day during business hours. Rolled out SDK 0.12.3 last week. Downgrading reduced but did not remove. Impacting autosuggest flow.

joseph (eng-infra): Can you try a quick client-side mitigation: reduce concurrency to 2 or set `max_concurrency=2` in the SDK and enable `streaming_chunk_size=64`. Also try sending `X-RW-Client-Timeout: 30` header. If that reduces failures we can push a temporary customer-facing mitigation.

emma (support): I've asked Acme to test reducing to 2 and setting that header, telling them we'll follow up in 30m.

deepak (eng-runtime): For repro on our side, running this script simulates:
```
# repro.sh (approx)
for i in $(seq 1 6); do
  curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","stream":true,"prompt":"$(yes "word" | head -n 2000 | tr -d "\n")"}' \
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
Run against staging with kvcache disabled to reproduce faster. I'll start a loop now.

sarah (oncall): Can we also add an early-reject on edge when per-worker queue > 12 so it returns 429/503 with Retry-After instead of letting things stall? That will be much friendlier to clients.

joseph (eng-infra): I can push an edge-proxy patch to early-reject above threshold and add a new metric `edge.reject_queued` to monitor. Targeting a deploy in ~30m to a canary region.

emma (support): Customer update sent: "We're rolling temporary client mitigations (lower concurrency) and deploying an edge patch to reduce stalls. We'll monitor and follow up." They replied :thumbsup:.

deepak (eng-runtime): After repro run I see blocked workers waiting on `kvcache.fetch` when prompt prefixes are large. Long term fix: make kvcache fetch async for streaming or prioritize new streams. I'll open a ticket to re-architect prefix fetch path.

joseph (eng-infra): Deployed early-reject to canary edge-1. Initial telemetry: queue_depth spikes still happen but rejected requests up 0.7% — good sign.

emma (support): Notified Acme of canary deploy, asked them to test again.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0928-71 (link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0928-71) — assigning to eng-runtime + eng-infra.

sarah (oncall): Followup plan: 1) wait for customer test results 2) if failures persist rollout edge patch globally 3) deepak to prototype async kvcache 4) postmortem if >1% error rate next 24h.

emma (support): Thanks team — I'll keep customer comms open and update thread when they confirm.
